'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Bentley Boyd DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Bentley Boyd]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
